titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 8/2021 (ޤައުމީ ޕޭމަންޓް ސިސްޓަމްގެ ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the National Payment System Act (Act No. 8/2021). It makes three changes to the law: it rewrites Article 15, it rewrites Article 50(a), and it adds a new Article 50-1. The new Article 50-1 sets out several sub-articles that refer back to Article 18 and include a money amount, with figures of MVR 100,000 and MVR 10,000,000 printed. The scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain, including exactly who the new rules apply to.
whyItMatters: If it becomes law, businesses that run or take part in payment systems could face new or changed rules and money penalties under the Act.
keyProvisions: Replaces Article 15 with a new text made up of two sub-articles, one of them a list of four numbered points. The details could not be read reliably.
Replaces Article 50(a), which refers to Article 18(a) and Article 18(c)-(d). The wording could not be read reliably.
Adds a new Article 50-1 after Article 50. It has several lettered sub-articles that refer back to Article 18 and to Article 50.
One sub-article of the new Article 50-1 sets an amount between MVR 100,000 and MVR 10,000,000. The scan suggests this is a fine range, but this is not certain.
Another sub-article of Article 50-1 introduces a defined term in quotation marks, whose meaning could not be read.
Clause 4 sets when the amendment takes effect, apparently after ratification and publication in the gazette.
whoIsAffected: Probably companies and people who operate or take part in payment systems in the Maldives, though the scans do not make this fully clear.
statedReasons: The explanatory note names the National Payment System Act and says the bill is submitted to amend it. The rest of the note could not be read reliably.
